prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible, approach it. If not found, scan area. Take object, move and perform task. list of available nodes: <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = TakeObject    />     <Action ID = MoveToDestination    />     <Condition ID = IsDestinationReached    />     <Action ID = CheckObjectStatus    />     <SubTree ID = PerformSpecificTask    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToDestination
			IF IsDestinationReached? THEN
			DO CheckObjectStatus
	ELSE
		DO PerformSpecificTask
	END
